summary: Hafnia Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated June 30, 2026, announcing the planned CEO succession. Mikael Skov will step down as CEO effective September 1, 2026, and Søren Steenberg Jensen, EVP Head of Asset Management, has been appointed as his successor. Skov is nominated to join the board, subject to an Extraordinary General Meeting. The change is described as planned and orderly. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors were named. This is a management transition event and does not involve an acquisition, tender, or other special situation restructuring. What to watch: shareholder confirmation at the EGM and any strategic shifts under new leadership.
